newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close sharply down.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close sharply down.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished sharply lower on Tuesday despite the central bank's issuance of T$8 billion in negotiable certificates of deposits to mop up liquidity, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 6.081 percent against Monday's 6.323 close -- still far outside the central bank's 5.00-5.5 percent target zone -- with 30-day commercial paper falling to 6.25-6.30 against 6.35-6.40.
Despite a loose liquidity, dealers said the central bank has hinted it would not want to see the money rates to fall further at the moment.
The benchmark 86/4 bond yields jumped in morning trade, but no trade was reported in the afternoon.
